mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_survey_response ( response_id, survey_id, member_id, client_ip, submitted_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{responseId}, #{surveyId}, #{memberId}, #{clientIp}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT r.response_id, r.survey_id, r.member_id, r.client_ip, r.submitted_at, r.created_by, r.created_ip, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_ip, r.updated_at, m.login_id AS member_login_id, m.member_name AS member_name FROM tb_survey_response r LEFT JOIN tb_member m ON m.member_id = r.member_id WHERE r.response_id = #{responseId}

SELECT response_id, survey_id, member_id, client_ip, submitted_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at FROM tb_survey_response WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId} AND member_id = #{memberId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_survey_response WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId}

SELECT r.response_id, r.survey_id, r.member_id, r.client_ip, r.submitted_at, r.created_by, r.created_ip, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_ip, r.updated_at, m.login_id AS member_login_id, m.member_name AS member_name FROM tb_survey_response r LEFT JOIN tb_member m ON m.member_id = r.member_id WHERE r.survey_id = #{surveyId} ORDER BY r.submitted_at DESC
